script.text: hi hi! cyrus added me. i'm brooke, from his lab section

script.text: Welcome. Brooke has been asking to join these lunches for weeks.

script.text: love that. ok, my pitch: cafe lunch. coffee, sandwiches, good chats

script.text: something fresh! salads, grain bowls, that kind of thing

script.speaker: maya
script.text: the coast. i've been saving since march. i will eat toast for dinner if i have to

script.text: Brooke, I mentioned this in lab, but for the record: I'm allergic to peanuts. No peanut butter, no peanut sauce, nothing sprinkled with peanuts.

script.speaker: brooke
script.text: got it. peanut-free, always. i'll check menus with you

script.speaker: maya
script.text: careful, cafes sneak peanut butter into EVERYTHING. smoothies, cookies, all of it

script.speaker: brooke
script.text: this is already my favourite group chat. let's make lunch a regular thing!

script.speaker: cyrus
script.text: Agreed. I'll put it in the calendar.

script.text: assistant pls hurry, i'm down to my last granola bar
